The '''Goff system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" />

[[Task Force Vengeance/Legends|Task Force Vengeance]] [[Attack on Goff|seized]] an [[Goff Platform|Airam supply platform]] in the system as a demonstration of Imperial naval power, and to use it as a forward staging point, and later fought off a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Attack on the Compellor|counterattack]] aimed at the [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Interdictor Cruiser]] ''[[Compellor/Legends|Compellor]]''.

Later still, the Rebels lured the Imperial [[Battlegroup Orion]] into a trap in the Goff system.

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
During the initial capture of the platform and when defending the ''Compellor'', [[Avenger Squadron/Legends|Avenger Squadron]] still used their upgraded [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptor]] craft while they had already been equipped with [[TIE/ad starfighter]]s by the time the ambush at Goff (third battle) took place. This establishes that the ambush took place later than the other two battles.
